business.rankingBody: At most 2 cards labelled "Ad" appear at the top (only businesses with verified documents). All others follow the same rule for everyone: businesses with verified documents first, then review score (the number of reviews counts too), then those in your district, then the most recently updated. Membership plans do not change the order.
